points.text: The US suspended Microsoft, Adobe and other IT firms from the PERM green card program, freezing new and pending applications for foreign workers amid accusations of visa fraud.
President Donald Trump said the US would not attack Iran before the midterm elections, citing what he called productive discussions with Tehran.
Israel said the British consulate in East Jerusalem had ceased operations, while the UK said it would continue its presence and services as UK Mission, Jerusalem.
US prosecutors added a conspiracy to commit torture charge against former Venezuelan president Nicolás Maduro and his wife, who already face drug trafficking and firearms charges.
Canadian writer Anne Carson won the Nobel Prize in Literature; the Swedish Academy cited her bold and inventive work and its creation of new literary forms.
